answer: Ferrous Decay Weighting. Each identity's vote weight decays with a ferrous-style oxidation clock: unused identities lose influence at a fixed rate, so a sybil farm must keep every clone active to stay viable. The kernel rule: weight = activity recency × log(1 + transfers), recalculated per epoch. An attacker running N clones pays N × maintenance cost per epoch, and the prism effect means costs scale faster than influence since dormant clones decay to near-zero.
